entries.name: baseline
entries.note: Starting point. Dominated on every dimension by merged_abc_v1.

entries.name: fast_keywords
entries.mechanism: precompiled keyword cache (Map keyword -> {lower, isPhrase, wordRegex}) + bounded LRU lowercase cache
entries.note: Proposer A. Dominated by merged_abc_v1 but merged into it.

entries.name: inverted_index_selection
entries.mechanism: inverted-index scorer: single-word token Set lookup + 2-char-prefix prefilter for multi-word keywords; bit-exact parity with legacy scoreFamilyTiered (14520 comparisons)
entries.note: Proposer C. Dominated by merged_abc_v1 but merged into it.

entries.name: archetype_caps
entries.mechanism: archetype classifier (chat / video / ai-product) + data-viz signal detector; unions with detectCapabilities for web families only
entries.note: Proposer B. Latency cost accepted for +27pp ideasai capHit. Merged with A+C.

entries.name: merged_abc_v1
entries.mechanism: A (fast_keywords) + B (archetype_caps) + C (inverted_index_selection) composed. A+C touch orthogonal hot-path code (keyword matcher + family scorer); B adds a capability inference stage. A+C speed wins offset B's inference cost, net -47% p95.
entries.note: Generation 1 frontier point. Dominates baseline on every dimension. Tests: 347/351 (same 4 pre-existing failures as clean main).
